module: Route subtree of the livery decal editor (included by liveries.edit.decals). Add flow: decals -> camera (view choice) -> selector (decal grid) -> transform -> settings; separate branches for material, mirror and transform of an already selected decal. The hooks point to ui_liveries_routeLifecycleCallbacks.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.
The screenId starts with "liveries.edit.decals" so that the preparation and cleanup of ui_liveries_decal remain valid across the whole branch (code comment).

Root.desc: {screenId = "liveries.edit.decals", title = "ui.liveries.edit.decals", backTarget = "liveries.edit", targetScope = "layers-manager", scopeTree (liveries-decals-hidden, layers-manager), onEnter onDecalsEnter, onMount onDecalsMount, onLeave onDecalsLeave}

Children.desc: camera (> selector > transform > settings), material, mirror, transform (> settings), each with a backTarget to the previous level.

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
